title: Real-World Patterns
description: Apply React Query to real-world application patterns including authentication, form integration, and complex data workflows.
longDescription: This module covers real-world application patterns with React Query including authentication flows with token refresh, form integration with React Hook Form, complex dependent queries, polling for real-time data, and migrating from legacy data fetching libraries like Axios or custom hooks. You will build production-ready integrations that handle edge cases like 401 errors, optimistic updates, real-time data synchronization, and incremental migration from existing codebases without breaking users.
whatYouLearn: Implement authentication flows with automatic token refresh using React Query
Integrate React Query with form libraries like React Hook Form
Set up polling for real-time data updates
Migrate from legacy data fetching patterns to React Query
Handle 401 errors globally with retry and token refresh
Combine WebSockets with React Query cache for live data
